visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a golden-brown pastry being cut with a silver fork initiates the sequence, followed by a woman with her hair in a bun, wearing a beige top and black skirt, walking through the automatic glass sliding doors of a Saint Marc Cafe. The lighting is bright and warm, reflecting off the clean interior surfaces. (2) Detailed shots focus on a staff member's hands wearing blue sanitary gloves, meticulously preparing dough on a clean white countertop. Trays of chocolate croissants, branded as 'Chococro' in orange and white paper sleeves, are highlighted on wooden shelves. The camera moves across displays of egg-topped danishes and rows of packaged sandwiches under golden-hued studio lighting. (3) The main character, now in a grey ribbed sweater, is seated at a wooden table inside the cafe. She uses a fork and knife to eat a flaky pastry while a white ceramic mug sits nearby. The background reveals a modern urban cafe setting with large windows showing city trees and other customers working on laptops. (4) The scene shifts to Day 2, where the woman, seen from behind in a fuzzy cream jacket, enters the same cafe. A close-up shows maple syrup being poured from a small metallic pitcher onto thick, powdered-sugar-dusted French toast. She is then framed sitting by a window overlooking a multi-lane city road with vehicles passing by. (5) On Day 3, she enters wearing a black puffer jacket and a white crossbody bag. She interacts with a staff member at the counter, receiving a brown paper takeout bag. Later, she is seated at an outdoor white table near a JR station entrance, holding a croissant and a paper coffee cup while looking at the camera. (6) The video concludes with promotional graphics on a pink background featuring social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, alongside the brand logo of a small house with trees. Text overlays provide account handles and a website URL.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 日本早餐吃什麼. 被咖啡耽誤的麵包店!. 愛到連續吃三天. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Variety]: 口袋名單. (3) [Subtitle]: 日本超強連鎖咖啡廳 Saint Marc Cafe 聖摩珂咖啡. (4) [Logo]: CHOCOCRO (巧酷樂). (5) [Subtitle]: 他們家最有名的招牌是這個! 我個人超愛. 麵包都在店內現烤製作. 看到都餓了. [Slogan]: 套餐包含 三選一 麵包 + 飲品. 早上提供早餐套餐 最便宜只要500日圓!. (6) [Subtitle]: Day1 太陽蛋丹麥麵包 + 海鮮濃湯. 今天想吃鹹的. 櫃台有貼心指示牌可以直接手指跟店員溝通!. (7) [Subtitle]: 麵包可以請店員複熱喔. 外層酥酥的真好吃. 大冷天需要喝杯熱湯. 這個海鮮味很濃郁. 套餐份量剛好 完吃不會太撐. (8) [Subtitle]: Day2 法式吐司 + 拿鐵. 昨天看到它的法式吐司感覺很不錯. 決定直接來試吃!. 有附上楓糖可以自己淋上去. 奶油香氣重. 早餐就能吃到這個真的是太幸福了. (9) [Subtitle]: Day3 CHOCOCRO (巧酷樂) + 黑咖啡. 今天趕時間直接外帶出去吃. 終於吃到我最愛的CHOCOCRO (巧酷樂) 啦. (10) [Subtitle]: 它外層酥酥脆脆 裡面有入口即化的苦甜巧克力. 我全家人都愛這一味 買太少會不夠吃. 對了, CHOCOCRO (巧酷樂) 每個月都會推出限定口味唷!. (11) [Variety]: 連這個是限定口味. (12) [Slogan]: 早餐套餐只供應到11:00 記得注意時間. (11:00後會換成午間套餐). 快存起來 之後到日本吃. (13) [Logo]: japanuts.com. 日本失心瘋.
